asks: How is a team's spend on models held across its members' Macs?
answer: Each member's Silo holds a budget on all of that member's computers, set by the team's rule set. It is a rule, exact on that Mac, since the boundary there sees every model call. A team total is not enforced across Macs: it is the sum of what members' Silos report, and it is shown as such. A budget shared by several people is exact only where their computers run on one host.
